title: Conjectures on Sums of Consecutive Primes
summary: We study additive properties of consecutive prime numbers and the primality of the sums they generate. For a given prime number $p_n$, we consider the sums \[ S_k(p_n) = p_n + p_{n+1} + \cdots + p_{n+k-1}, \] where $k \ge 3$ is an odd integer. We first formulate an existence conjecture asserting that, for every prime number $p_n$, there exists at least one odd length $k \ge 3$ such that $S_k(p_n)$ is itself a prime number.
